results.name: ACTIVITY_BELONGS_TO_CASE
results.description: Every prov:Activity must have exactly one wf:belongsToCase link (integrity: each event belongs to exactly one case).

results.name: ACTIVITY_HAS_AGENT
results.description: Every prov:Activity must have prov:wasAssociatedWith an agent.

results.name: WAS_INFORMED_BY_TEMPORAL_CONSISTENCY
results.description: If activity B prov:wasInformedBy activity A, then both must have prov:startedAtTime and A.startedAtTime must be less than or equal to B.startedAtTime.

results.name: PAYMENT_HANDLED_BY_SYSTEM
results.description: Every 'Payment Handled' activity must be associated with resource SYSTEM (xes-attr:org_resource).

results.name: PAYMENT_HANDLED_NOT_BY_EMPLOYEE
results.description: Every 'Payment Handled' activity must not be associated with role EMPLOYEE (xes-attr:org_role).

results.name: PAYMENT_PROVENANCE_CHAIN
results.description: A payment is valid only if Payment Handled wasInformedBy Request Payment, which wasInformedBy Final Approval, which wasInformedBy Declaration Submission, and all belong to the same case (prov:wasInformedBy+; optional steps such as PRE_APPROVER may appear between these milestones).
